title: Beat 213 - Oracle
description: A pale, blue-skinned woman with glowing white eyes sits enthroned in an ornate golden chair inside a cluttered, arched chamber. She operates a glowing turntable with one hand while a film clapperboard, film reels, scattered VHS tapes, popcorn, and movie posters surround her in a cinematic, mystical setting.
prompt: A mystical blue-skinned oracle woman with glowing white eyes wearing ornate golden robes sits on a decorated throne in a dark arched chamber. She is DJing on a glowing turntable with one hand while a film clapperboard rests on a pedestal beside her. The walls are covered with vintage movie posters, film reels hang from the ceiling, VHS tapes and popcorn are scattered on the floor. Cinematic surreal atmosphere, intricate details, moody lighting.
